name: accessibility
description: Build and audit any UI to WCAG 2.2 AA: a success-criteria map by builder task, structure and names, keyboard and focus (2.4.11), targets (2.5.8) and dragging (2.5.7), ARIA and APG patterns, live regions, reflow and text spacing, forced colours, screen-reader cheat-sheets and test plans, axe-core with Playwright, accessibility statements and the legal landscape (EAA, ADA Title II, Section 508, EN 301 549, Israel IS 5568), plus an audit rubric and report template.
